connector.name: AiPayGen - 65+ AI Tools as an MCP Server

connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.aipaygen.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the Python package aipaygen-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the damien829 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
